versions.changelog:
- Bumped the documented version to 1.0.3 in SKILL.md.
- Changed displayed skill name from "phy-test-data-factory" to "Test Data Factory".

- Version bump from 1.0.1 to 1.0.2 in SKILL.md metadata.
- No functional or user-facing changes; update is metadata-only.

- Changed author and version metadata to Canlah AI and 1.0.1.
- Added a homepage field with https://canlah.ai.
- No functional or behavioral changes to the skill; documentation/metadata only.

- Initial release of phy-test-data-factory.
- Generates realistic, schema-driven test data factories from Prisma, SQLAlchemy, Django, TypeORM, Zod, Pydantic, or raw SQL DDL.
- Supports TypeScript (Faker.js), Python (factory_boy + Faker), and SQL INSERT output.
- Handles relationships, enums, nullable fields, unique constraints, and edge-case variants.
- Pure local code generation with zero external API calls.
